mechanism: Valerian may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing diclofenac levels; additive CNS depression and increased GI bleeding risk from NSAID use with sedating herbal.
action: Monitor for increased diclofenac side effects (GI symptoms, dizziness); consider alternative analgesic or reduce diclofenac dose if combined use necessary; counsel on GI protective measures.
